turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hanging in there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The landlord wants to keep two hundred pounds of my deposit for a stain on the carpet.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. Is the stain really yours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, red wine. But the carpet was ancient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then you could challenge the amount through the deposit scheme, or accept it and move on. Which matters more, the money or the hassle?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a bit, my kid needs me. I'll come back to you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, sure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, are you crying? It's a cartoon.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Shut up. The little robot just wanted a friend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Here, have a tissue.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Thanks. Don't you dare tell anyone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm telling everyone. Was it the bit with the flower?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Obviously it was the bit with the flower.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I teared up a bit too, honestly.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ha! I knew it. Want to put the next one on?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm here again, let's continue.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Your deposit. Disputing the two hundred, or accepting it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll pay. I just want it done.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Understandable. Ask for the deduction in writing so the rest comes back quickly.
